decisions.reason: As a large telecom operator we would usually keep a newly launched conferencing service for at least another year, even though competition and price pressure in collaboration tools are high.
The data-centre metro connectivity offer shows clear enterprise relevance and already has a concrete adoption signal, so it fits our strategic network portfolio.
Optical spectrum connectivity is a specialist infrastructure product with strategic value for wholesale and large enterprise customers, and a dedicated product page suggests active positioning.
A voice number ordering portal is a useful operational add-on for business voice services and is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon after launch unless uptake is very weak.
Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony service in a declining segment, so we would be relatively likely to phase it out and reallocate resources to IP-based services.
A direct voice network connection service remains complementary to enterprise voice and interconnection business, making near-term withdrawal unlikely.
